evidence.passive_collapse: All new autonomous outputs lie within 0.0083-0.0364mV RMS of a no-ionic-current passive control; that control has 1.893mV target RMS versus1.877-1.887mV for candidates. The72percent voltage improvement over52 does not establish restored ionic behavior.
evidence.decoder: For every trained arm, fixed decoder box bounds preclude passing current thresholds on36/36 imposed-reference cases (333/396 channel-cases). This is a frozen-weight feasibility result, not a general impossibility for latent10.
evidence.initialization: The short10ms future-assisted h0 fit changes100ms mean NRMSE by less than0.1percent. This alone cannot rule out initialization because decoder output is infeasible and the oracle is local/short.
evidence.memory: Multiscale initialization increases sampled local Jacobian singular values from approximately0.02-0.07 to0.88-0.97, but does not improve final autonomous quality. More retention alone is insufficient; useful information may not be encoded or exposed by readout.
evidence.optimization: All12 members select the final1200checkpoint and development loss continues to fall. This is evidence against claiming convergence, not proof that additional compute alone will solve the problem.

hypotheses.claim: Restricted learned output range and poorly balanced fitting suppress dynamic current events.
hypotheses.contrast: Refit an identically calibrated family-wise log decoder on frozen latent trajectories; check achievable range before interpreting other repairs. Compare current peaks/charge/timing as well as log loss, with a no-current negative control.
hypotheses.falsifier: A verified range-capable decoder still fails on latent histories but succeeds on a full-state diagnostic control, indicating missing latent information rather than output range alone.

hypotheses.claim: The encoder fails to put distinct physical starting states in distinguishable latent states.
hypotheses.contrast: With the same trainable decoder, compare encoder frozen versus trainable while recurrence is frozen. Multi-start future-assisted h0 fits at10/100/1000ms are separate nonselectable diagnostics.
hypotheses.falsifier: A sufficiently optimized h0 gives no improvement after decoder feasibility is established; this weakens, but does not logically exclude, initialization limitation.

hypotheses.claim: The recurrent state does not retain or organize information needed for future currents.
hypotheses.contrast: With the same trainable decoder, compare recurrence frozen versus trainable at each encoder setting; probe matched-current histories with different future responses and reset sensitivity.
hypotheses.falsifier: Frozen recurrence plus decoder-only repair matches trainable recurrence across long histories and interventions.

hypotheses.claim: The objective/sampling/gradient horizon prioritizes quiet states and does not sufficiently train rare events or long memory.
hypotheses.contrast: Before full training, audit per-channel and event/quiet gradient contributions, run tiny-subset overfit checks and same-trajectory budget curves. An event-balanced objective is fixed across the main matrix, so that matrix alone does not estimate the objective's causal effect.
hypotheses.falsifier: Balanced support and successful subset fitting still do not transfer; examine latent information/recurrence rather than declaring more data sufficient.

proposed_main_matrix.shared: A calibrated range-capable decoder is trainable in every arm. Same latent10, same V/Ca online inputs, family layout, training streams, seeds and thresholds.
proposed_main_matrix.contrasts: DE-D and DER-DR isolate encoder repair; DR-D and DER-DE isolate recurrent repair, conditional on common decoder training. Interaction is DER-DE-DR+D. Frozen52b and no-ionic-current controls prevent mistaking passive collapse for success.
diagnostic_controls: No ionic currents, same passive membrane/input
Postfreeze multi-start h0 oracle with multiple horizons
Teacher-state readout diagnostic, not online candidate input
Matched computational cost, all current/timing and autonomous thresholds
proposed_main_matrix.not_yet_preregistered: Exact decoder width, objective weights, budgets and support counts require a next-task protocol before any execution. No experiment is launched by this proposal.
